title: The Ministry for the Future
author: Kim Stanley Robinson
summary: A near-future story begins with a deadly heatwave in India, then follows a new United Nations agency tasked with representing the interests of future generations. It looks at the many ways people try to stop climate disaster.
readIf: you want a serious, information-rich look at how the world might actually respond to climate change.
skipIf: you want a plot-driven novel, as much of it is made up of essays, reports and short vignettes.

pairings.reason: A more personal and frightening story of life in a world already coming apart from climate pressure.
Another thoughtful novel about building a better society, in which ideas and politics drive the story.
